protocol: self_model_v1: Block-8 minimal experiment. Mixed-difficulty 2D classification; an explicit self-model head is trained to predict the answer head's correctness on each input (metacognition), vs softmax-probability self-report and fixed overconfidence. Criterion: self_model ECE <= 0.15 and >= 0.05 lower than both controls -- an explicit self-model gives reliable 'do I know this?' estimates.
